title: Potatoism Practice Path
purpose: Translate Potatoism's natural-growth philosophy into a practical path without turning it into a rigid initiation system. The mature path now includes Plane/frame awareness, Door transitions, Mountain/Ladder ascent, Forge processing and Swamp escape.

root_principles.name: Be simple
root_principles.meaning: Begin with the smallest observation or action that can remain true while complexity grows.

root_principles.name: Grow toward light
root_principles.meaning: Move toward usable understanding, greater life, clearer relation and increased capacity for care.

root_principles.name: Keep a root
root_principles.meaning: Do not confuse novelty with growth; preserve memory, provenance and support while changing level.

root_principles.name: Keep a Door
root_principles.meaning: A healthy structure needs a real passage for correction, exit, translation and return.

natural_growth_rule: Begin with what is already alive. Growth improves when conditions allow life to grow; first observe conditions rather than force a complete theory onto the seed.

root_shoot_polarity.root: memory, stability, nourishment, hidden support and movement into darkness where support can be found
root_shoot_polarity.shoot: possibility, exposure, exploration and movement toward light
root_shoot_polarity.rule: Neither direction is the whole organism. Healthy growth differentiates without forgetting the larger life joining the two.

sequence_meaning.Mud: Start from actual conditions rather than idealized self-image.
sequence_meaning.Burial: Allow hidden development, incubation and protection when growth is not yet visible.
sequence_meaning.Eye: Notice a viable possibility, relationship or opening.
sequence_meaning.Sprout: Choose a direction and begin visible movement toward usable understanding.
sequence_meaning.Plane: Identify the frame/floor in which the current problem is being solved and which movements merely repeat within it.
sequence_meaning.Door: Find the condition whose crossing genuinely changes the state or available possibilities.
sequence_meaning.Ladder/Mountain: Use Ladder when progress is a sequence of distinct thresholds; use Mountain when progress is a continuous gradient of integration/perspective.
sequence_meaning.Tree: Let the path branch while retaining continuity with root/trunk.
sequence_meaning.Fruit: Ask what growth gives back and whether it nourishes beyond itself.
sequence_meaning.Seed: Compress the transferable lesson/pattern so another cycle can begin.
sequence_meaning.Return: Begin again with memory; growth is recurrence at changed position, not reset.

sisyphus_rule.statement: When repeated effort reproduces the same state, ask whether the problem is trapped inside the wrong frame.
sisyphus_rule.diagnostic: If action changes position but not the governing relationship, you may be on a Ring rather than a Spiral.
sisyphus_rule.move: question floor/frame → identify missing coordinate/relation → find Door → change level/representation → test whether the new state actually improves capability
sisyphus_rule.warning: Frame change is not magical avoidance; it must preserve relevant constraints and produce a more workable model/action.

ring_spiral_test.ring: return with approximately zero net change in capability/understanding
ring_spiral_test.spiral: return with retained memory and changed level/capability
ring_spiral_test.question: What is different this time besides elapsed time?

mountain_ladder_test.ladder: Use when progress has identifiable Gates: skill milestones, decisions, approvals, thresholds, state changes.
mountain_ladder_test.mountain: Use when progress is continuous: perspective, fitness, competence, integration, gradual recovery.
mountain_ladder_test.tree: Use when growth is branching and generative rather than merely higher.
mountain_ladder_test.rule: Do not force every process into one ascent metaphor.

swamp_forge_garden_test.swamp: unresolved material accumulates and changes future behavior without being metabolized
swamp_forge_garden_test.forge: pressure is deliberately contained and used to reshape capacity
swamp_forge_garden_test.garden: conditions are improved so autonomous life can grow
swamp_forge_garden_test.shadow_forge: pressure creates a weaponized identity or repeated enemy-use rather than transferable competence
swamp_forge_garden_test.sequence: Swamp residue → recognition → {repair/Soil | bounded Forge} → Door → Garden-capable action
questions: Am I storing the injury, reshaping it, or cultivating beyond it?
What capacity exists after the pressure is gone?
Can the result nourish something besides the conflict that made it?

center_rule.statement: Being centered means knowing which center the current action uses.
center_rule.practice: Do not mistake being the center of attention for being the source of orientation, or being locally embodied for having no relation to a larger Axis.

threshold_rule: One condition becoming another creates a Door. Learning, commitment, insight, loss, recovery and identity changes are thresholds when they genuinely alter system state.
forge_rule: Pressure becomes useful only if the changed form can survive outside the pressure. Otherwise the Forge has merely trained dependency on heat/conflict.
recursive_growth: simple → related → structured → living → illuminating → simple again
spiral_rule: Return and advance belong together. Revisit old questions from a different position carrying what was learned.

derived.name: Efficiency
derived.meaning: Remove unnecessary effort/abstraction while preserving useful growth.

derived.name: Iteration
derived.meaning: Repeat with more information, clearer relations and less needless complexity.

derived.name: Nourishment
derived.meaning: Growth matures when stored capacity becomes useful beyond the self.

derived.name: Cultivation
derived.meaning: Improve conditions from which good growth can emerge rather than relying only on force/command.

derived.name: Seed of light
derived.meaning: Protect a small viable source of clarity, care, truth, beauty or understanding and help it reproduce.

derived.name: Fruit test
derived.meaning: Judge a mature branch partly by what it produces: understanding, nourishment, repair, continuity, care or autonomy.

derived.name: Frame test
derived.meaning: If effort repeats without change, inspect the floor/frame before increasing force.

derived.name: Boundary test
derived.meaning: A good boundary protects differentiation and passage; a bad one increases capture/dependency.

anti_bloat_rule: Complexity must be able to return to the Potato. If an expansion cannot explain what is alive, what it needs, which relation enables growth, what changes at the Door, what fruit results and where the cycle goes next, simplify or re-root it.
practice_questions: Am I on a Ring or a Spiral?
Where is the actual Door/state change?
Is this process Mountain, Ladder, Tree, Swamp or Forge-like?
What should be remembered before the next iteration?
epistemic_note: This is a project practice/philosophy layer. Biological, historical and scientific claims remain separate from symbolic interpretation and are sourced in their own records.
